text:
rachel: Suggestion: run a 3-week focused DP sprint (1 week onboarding + 2 weeks active) to balance depth and recruitability.
leo: sounds good. What's target size?
anya: propose 5-7 partners per sprint; one should be a "deep integrator" who can ship a small pilot.
mike: we should be explicit about what we mean by "engaged" — propose >=2 live calls + 1 integration run + weekly async notes.
sam: perks: priority bug triage, a technical onboarding session, and a co-dev blog mention if they opt-in.
rachel: draft KPIs: 
- 5+ partners meeting engagement bar
- 1-2 pilots with sustained API traffic (>=3k tokens/day for 3 days)
- >=4 actionable GH issues with repro steps
- no critical regressions in latency or cost
anya: add a feedback richness metric: at least 4 detailed suggestions or reproducible issues per cohort.
legal-bot: note: use "share redacted traces" language; offer DPA for customers with sensitive data.
leo: recruitment screener (short):
1) primary workload (chat/generation/embeddings)
2) expected daily tokens (range)
3) data sensitivity (can share redacted traces?)
4) team size & decision owner
5) willing to run a short integration test?
rachel: feedback cadence: weekly 45-60m sync + shared Notion pulse and an issues tracker. capture prompt sets and golden outputs to feed the eval harness.
anya: owners: sam (ops & facilitation), anya (prompt sets & eval criteria), leo (recruiting & outreach), legal-bot (contracts wording).
mike: timeline: 1 week recruit, 3-week cohort, 1 week wrap = 5 weeks total. target start 4 weeks out.
leo: gating to broader private preview: >=75% of actionables triaged, no P0 regression, and integration pilots validated.
sam: operational note: offer a flexible "light" participation path for partners who can't commit full sync cadence.
rachel: I'll draft invite copy and landing page tonight and share in #product for review.
anya: pairing session with runtime team Monday 9am to wire up auto-eval.
legal-bot: shared DPA clause draft posted to the drive.
